rendered_from: This branch's own files only: the phase-6 scene (audio/index.html — the audio-locked scene of record, byte-identical to phase 4's post-QA file) frame-captured at 30 fps, muxed with this branch's phase-6 master WAV.

audio_on_delivered_file.standard: ≈ −14 LUFS (within ±1) and TP ≤ −1 dBTP — both measured on the delivered MP4, not on an intermediate

audio_onsets.method: silencedetect (−45 dB, min 0.30 s) on the assembled voice track; line onsets compared with the locked starts in audio/audio.json

lines.note: the take's speech crosses threshold inside its trim window; the derived first-word instant is 7.776
soft attack in the source take; the derived first-word instant (17.063) agrees with the probe
Δ0.13 s — inside the take's lead-in; the named word-timing tolerance (register R-3)
Δ0.125 s — the take's lead-in, as L5

audio_onsets.verdict: Every line starts where the pause map locked it (within its take's own lead-in). This probe is also what caught the first assembly's placement defect — the correction is recorded in audio/audio.json.

pause_map_measured.method: silence intervals ≥ 0.30 s on the assembled voice track, matched to the inter-line boundaries

joints.note: the largest excess — L4's soft attack (see onsets)

pause_map_measured.verdict: Every joint measures at or above its planned size (the excess is speech decay/lead inside the trim windows — the planned gap is stem-edge to stem-edge) and the designed hierarchy holds: the think beat is the longest silence in the piece, then the concept shift, then the two suspenses.

frames.scene_qa: 16 frames captured from the scene and VIEWED at phase 4; six defects found, fixed, and re-verified on 9 re-shot frames (the log is in scene/scene.json).
frames.render_integrity: 1,712 frames captured at a true 1080×1920 (Emulation device-metrics override — a first capture pass at the bare window size produced 1080×1777 viewport crops and was discarded in full; recorded here so the method travels). Frame set complete (0–1711, no gaps), sizes verified.
frames.mp4_vs_scene: MP4 frame grabs at t = 5.5 / 15.0 / 29.7 / 52.8 s differ from the corresponding scene frames by 585–2,798 pixels above a 16-level threshold (≤0.13% — H.264 edge noise); two grabs (29.7 count verdict, 52.8 digit expansion) were viewed directly from the delivered MP4 and read as designed.

editability.method: ?edit=1 inspector on the phase-6 scene at t = 27.5 s, frames captured at a true 1080×1920
editability.result: Setting an override on wd-counter (dy +40) changed 4,951 pixels; the override persisted across a reload (0 differing pixels between the two post-reload frames); clearing the overrides restored the original frame exactly (0 differing pixels). The shipped scene is the editable source, not a baked derivative.
